metadata.description: wasitme: was it me, or the agent? Reads your own local Claude Code and Codex session logs and says whether your setup changed or the agent did. Local-only. Independent; not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic or OpenAI.

plugins.name: wasitme
plugins.description: A glanceable pane and quiet band for Claude Code, a /wasitme:report skill, and hooks that keep the local scan fresh. The mod reads only ~/.wasitme/glance.json and never touches the network. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic.
